summary: Adial Pharmaceuticals acquired Azora Therapeutics via a two-step merger under an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated June 11, 2026. Adial issued 437,474 shares of common stock and 12,930.617 shares of Series A convertible preferred stock (each convertible into 1,000 common shares) to Azora stockholders. The transaction is structured as a tax-free reorganization. No per-share price, premium, or implied value is stated. The board's recommendation and advisors are not named. The merger closed immediately upon filing, with no regulatory clock mentioned. Watch for conversion mechanics of the preferred stock and any overhang from the newly issued shares; risk-arb is moot as deal is closed.
